title: KPI Tilemap: Sprint Lens & Go-live Checklog
content:
Purpose:
A compact, sprint-focused KPI tilemap combining roadmap lanes with explicit go-live readiness checks. Intended as a single-pane operational artifact for product-ops + release engineering to make fast launch decisions and gate traffic. This is a working sheet (in-review) — use as source for sprint planning and go/no-go syncs.

How to use:
- Each row = one launchable tile (feature or capability).
- Sprint Lens = sprint number or week-range where owner expects rollout.
- KPIs include primary metric, baseline, target, and guardrail thresholds for go/no-go.
- Readiness Gate is satisfied when all "Release Tasks" checked AND KPI smoke-tests pass in staging.

Tilemap (pipe-separated columns for quick pasting into sheets):
Feature | Sprint Lens | Owner | Primary KPI | Baseline (last 7d) | Target (first 2w) | Guardrail | Release Tasks | Rollback Criteria | Notes
hosted-api-throughput-optim | S62 (2026-03-02 → 2026-03-15) | Diego Alvarez | sustained RPS / GPU | 120 RPS | 220 RPS | p95 latency < 250ms & error rate < 0.5% | infra quota bump, autoscaler policy deploy, perf smoke, canary = 5% traffic | if p95 > 350ms for 10m OR error >1% revert autoscaler | need infra ticket for extra nvidia quota (TKT-1298)
streaming-low-latency-sla | S62 | Lina Patel | p95 tail latency (stream start) | 420ms | 200ms | p95 < 300ms | streaming lib upgrade, benchmark harness, client backpressure test | revert to previous lib if regress > 25% | client SDK release depends on this; coordinate DX
dedicated-autoscale-burst | S63 (2026-03-16 → 2026-03-29) | Marcus Rivera | sustained concurrency / cost per 1k tokens | 85 concurrency | 180 concurrency | sustain for 10m w/o error spike & cost delta < 15% | capacity pool config, e2e soak, SLA smoke, rollback script ready | if sustained cost > 25% above forecast pause burst | coordinate sales for customers on reserved capacity
private-deployments-vpc-onboard | S64 | Ava Chen | time-to-first-response (VPC onboarding) | 72h | <24h | onboarding success rate > 95% | onboarding doc, infra templates, KMS test, audit log validation | if >5% failures revert network change | security review pending (SOC checklist)
console-rollouts-canary | S62 → S63 | Priya Shah (ux) | activation rate on rollout route | N/A (new) | 10% DAU activation | crash-free rate > 99.5% & error spike < 0.3% | canary script, dashboard, alerting hooks, rollback flag | if crash-free < 99% revert or circuit-break | throttling feature to be disabled if issues
optimize-batching-reco | S63 | Tom Brody | token cost per 1k tokens | $4.20/1k | $2.90/1k | cost < $3.50/1k & quality delta < 1% BLEU-equivalent | quant profile deploy, eval suite, canary traffic | if quality regression > 1.5% revert quant profile | link to eval results in Confluence

Readiness Checklist (per tile):
- [ ] Owner confirms infra quotas and permissions (owner: owner)
- [ ] SRE has run perf soak with 95th percentile targets
- [ ] Observability: dashboard for primary KPI + error stream exists
- [ ] Alerting: action paths and oncall runbook linked (pager/team)
- [ ] Rollback plan documented and revert automation tested (dry-run)
- [ ] Security & compliance sign-off (if customer-facing or private deploy)
- [ ] Docs & SDKs: release note stub + breaking change check

Acceptance thresholds (examples):
- perf tile: p95 latency improvement >= 20% vs baseline AND error rate < 0.5% over 1h canary
- cost tile: cost per token reduction >= 15% while quality delta <= 1% on eval set
- onboarding tile: median TTF (time to first response) < target and success rate >= 95%

Quick tasks / outstanding risks:
- Confirm NVIDIA quota with infra (TKT-1298) — high risk for throughput tile.
- Streaming lib upgrade has flaky behavior on k8s node churn — schedule additional soak.
- Dedicated burst policy needs finance approval for temporary spend uplift (finance: FYI).

Mini runbook snippet (for on-call):
If canary shows p95 latency spike > guardrail:
1) Pause canary traffic (ops/canary -> 0%)
2) Trigger rollback automation to previous config image (ops/release-rollback)
summary: Sprint-focused KPI tilemap + go-live checklist to support product-ops run-decisioning for upcoming sprints. Designed for quick scan: owners, KPIs, guardrails, and explicit rollback criteria.
document_notes: Working sheet — keep short, copy rows into product-ops master tracker. Sync cadence: weekly triage meeting (Wed 10am PT). Includes links to Confluence/JIRA/GitHub for deeper artifacts.
